content.title: Health Funds
content.what: The health funds provide psychological and psychiatric services.
content.process: See your primary care doctor at your health fund and ask for a referral to a psychologist or psychiatrist.

content.title: Resilience Centers
content.process: Contact the resilience center nearest to where you live, from the list of centers.

content.title: Rehabilitation Department
content.who: Soldiers and security forces personnel who suffered psychological injury as a result of their service.
content.cost: Assistance is determined according to recognition and disability percentage. You can get approval for medical and mental health treatment while your application is still being reviewed.
content.process: Submit an application for disability recognition using a digital form. The Rehabilitation Department's "Biyadayim Tovot" (In Good Hands) center helps with filling out the application.

contacts.label: Digital form - application for disability recognition
Medical treatment during the recognition process
Biyadayim Tovot - help with submitting the application

content.title: National Insurance Institute (Bituach Leumi)
content.who: Victims of hostile acts (terror victims), people injured at work, and people who have been assessed with a psychiatric disability.
content.what: Benefits and recognition, vocational rehabilitation, and the Ministry of Health's rehabilitation basket for people assessed with a psychiatric disability of at least 40%.
